text:
claire: FYI partner CloudHarbor flagged a major usage variance on their AWS marketplace bill for Apr. Invoice shows $48,760 but partner reports $24,380 in their reconciliation. They think metered usage was double-counted across linked accounts.
tom: do we have the raw metering lines? can someone paste the suspect rows?
rachel: pulling export now. quick snippet below from the marketplace metering export (metering.csv):
```
customer_account,linked_account,usage_dimension,usage_quantity,usd_amount
acc-444,link-1,redwood-inference-seconds,100000,15000
acc-444,link-2,redwood-inference-seconds,100000,15000
acc-444,link-1,redwood-inference-seconds,100000,15000  # appears duplicated with link-1 repeated
```
partner-ops: CloudHarbor says they saw only two linked accounts and expected total 200k seconds -> $30k. Our invoice is $48,760 after fees/tax which doesn't match either.
billing-bot: upload complete: marketplace_aws_apr_2026_metering.csv -> /finance/partner-uploads/CloudHarbor/INV-AWS-APR-2026-metering.csv
claire: breakdown from our invoice engine: base usage 300k seconds $45k; marketplace service fee + tax pushes to $48,760. The 300k appears to come from doubled link-1 entries (should be 200k).
tom: initial triage: looks like our aggregator merged per-linked-account reports without canonical dedupe key. Some AWS reports for linked accounts include the same meterlines when consolidated. I suspect we summed across linked accounts and again counted duplicate lines. Creating ticket BILL-1189.
rachel: action: (1) produce cleaned ledger that dedupes on (customer_account,usage_dimension,report_id,line_hash), (2) compute corrected invoice total, (3) draft credit note if net overbilling > $5k.
partner-ops: CloudHarbor wants an expedited correction. They already recognized discrepancy in their bookkeeping and asked for a credit memo rather than a future credit.
controller-mark: for credits > $10k we need controller approval + GL reversal mapping. what's the corrected delta?
claire: cleaned ledger calc yields corrected total $24,380 (matches partner). Net overcharge = $24,380; after reversing marketplace fees and VAT, credit amount to issue = $22,200.
controller-mark: I can approve up to $30k but need a one-line cause & remediation and the cleaned CSV attached to the approval request. Use REV-MKT-2 and GL 4110 for the reversal.
tom: I'll patch the aggregator to dedupe identical line_hash entries and add unit test. Scheduling hotfix for tonight.
rachel: drafting NetSuite credit memo CM-APR-CH-001, attaching cleaned ledger and justification: "Aggregator double-counted metering lines across linked AWS accounts; issuing credit to correct invoice." Routing to @controller-mark for signoff.
partner-ops: CloudHarbor confirms they want refund to original payment method. please include bank details in secure payment request.
claire: note payment run windows: next ACH run is Wednesday 04:00 UTC. If controller signs off today we can queue refund for that run.
controller-mark: signed off. please include txn note "Credit for duplicated metering lines - CloudHarbor INV-AWS-APR-2026" and cc finance-ops.
claire: done, NetSuite CM posted and refund scheduled for next run. Tom, please follow up on postmortem and verify no other partners impacted.
tom: will run a one-off scan across last 6 months for identical line_hash duplicates and report findings.
rachel: closing loop here; will update CloudHarbor and paste refund confirmation. :white_check_mark:
